question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing striker, Bob is playing right midfielder, and Claire is playing sweeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Finally, Claire and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) striker
(B) right midfielder
(C) sweeper
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: striker, right midfielder, sweeper
1. Alice ↔ Claire: sweeper, right midfielder, striker
2. Claire ↔ Bob: sweeper, striker, right midfielder
3. Claire ↔ Alice: right midfielder, striker, sweeper
Claire is playing sweeper, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
